name: Session 403 requests and upstream attempts
sql: SELECT r.request_id, r.started_at, r.path, r.model, r.status, r.request_headers, a.attempt_index, a.provider, a.status, a.request_headers, a.response_headers, a.response_body FROM requests AS r LEFT JOIN attempts AS a ON r.request_id = a.request_id WHERE r.session_id = {session:String} AND (r.status = 403 OR a.status = 403) ORDER BY r.started_at DESC

name: Skill occurrences this month
sql:
WITH matching_entries AS (
  SELECT e.entry_id
  FROM transcript_entries AS e FINAL
  INNER JOIN transcript_content AS c FINAL ON c.content_id = e.content_id
  WHERE e.occurred_at IS NOT NULL
    AND positionCaseInsensitive(c.text, {skill:String}) > 0
)
SELECT s.session_id, count() AS occurrences
FROM (
  SELECT rc.session_id, entry_id, min(rc.started_at) AS first_seen
  FROM request_contexts AS rc FINAL
  ARRAY JOIN rc.entry_ids AS entry_id
  WHERE rc.attempt_index = 0
    AND entry_id IN (SELECT entry_id FROM matching_entries)
  GROUP BY rc.session_id, entry_id
) AS s
WHERE s.first_seen >= toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(now({zone:String})), {zone:String})
  AND s.first_seen < now64(3)
GROUP BY s.session_id
ORDER BY s.session_id

name: Usage by model
sql: SELECT model, count() AS attempts, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens FROM analytics_events FINAL WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY model ORDER BY tokens DESC

name: Recent failures
sql: SELECT model, provider, upstream_status_code, error_class FROM analytics_events FINAL WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND succeeded = 0 ORDER BY requested_at_ns DESC LIMIT 100

name: Cost by provider
sql: SELECT provider, sum(known_cost_nano) AS cost_nano_usd FROM analytics_events FINAL WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY provider ORDER BY cost_nano_usd DESC
